Wanda is designed and built in France, with privacy, battery efficiency, and user autonomy as core principles.

Digital sovereignty means full control over your data, your music library, and your listening habits, with no telemetry, tracking, or vendor lock-in.

Wanda's source is licensed under the European Union Public Licence (EUPL-1.2), a copyleft licence built for European civil law. It covers network services as well as distribution, so there's no cloud loophole, keeping Wanda sovereign, transparent, and community-owned.
